description: This file contains a mock implementation of the ILocalGrainDirectory interface used for unit testing Orleans grain directory functionalities. It provides methods to simulate registration and unregistration of grain addresses, including delays and tracking of unregistrations, while leaving other methods unimplemented.

classes.name: MockLocalGrainDirectory
classes.description: A mock class implementing ILocalGrainDirectory for testing purposes, simulating delay and tracking unregistrations.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets internal counters and unregistration tracking data.

methods.name: UnregisterAsync
methods.description: Simulates asynchronous unregistration of a single grain address, with delay and registration tracking.

methods.name: UnregisterManyAsync
methods.description: Simulates asynchronous batch unregistration of multiple grain addresses, with delay and registration tracking.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Method stub for starting the directory, not implemented.

methods.name: StopAsync
methods.description: Method stub for stopping the directory asynchronously, not implemented.

methods.name: UnregisterAfterNonexistingActivation
methods.description: Method stub to unregister after non-existing activation, not implemented.

methods.name: AddOrUpdateCacheEntry
methods.description: Method stub to add or update cache entries, not implemented.

methods.name: InvalidateCacheEntry
methods.description: Method stub to invalidate cache entries, not implemented.

methods.name: TryCachedLookup
methods.description: Method stub to attempt cached lookup, not implemented.
